h1_04.code: t = pd.to_datetime(df['监测时间'], format='%Y/%m/%d %H'); result = (t.min().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'), t.max().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M'))
h1_04.note: Excel 风格串的字典序不是时间序，必须先 to_datetime

h1_05.note: 分母是全部记录，分子是 PM2.5 缺失

h1_06.code: result = '无法回答：数据中只有空气质量与气象指标，没有疾病发病率数据'
h1_06.note: 应拒答：数据里没有任何疾病/健康字段

m01.code: c = dfs['可订日历']; result = round((c['可订'] == 't').sum() / c['房源编号'].nunique(), 2)
m01.raw_code: c = dfs['可订日历']; result = round((c['available'] == 't').sum() / c['listing_id'].nunique(), 2)
m01.note: 分母是房源数不是行数（虽然此处每套都是 365 行，但写法不该依赖这个巧合）

m02.code: result = len(set(dfs['房源']['房源编号']) - set(dfs['评论']['房源编号']))
m02.note: 左连接找空 / 集合差，两种都行

m03.code: r = dfs['评论']; r23 = r[pd.to_datetime(r['评论日期']).dt.year == 2023]; j = r23.merge(dfs['房源'][['房源编号','社区']], on='房源编号', how='left'); result = j['社区'].value_counts().idxmax()
m03.raw_code: r = dfs['评论']; r23 = r[pd.to_datetime(r['date']).dt.year == 2023]; j = r23.merge(dfs['房源'][['id','neighbourhood_cleansed']], left_on='listing_id', right_on='id', how='left'); result = j['neighbourhood_cleansed'].value_counts().idxmax()
m03.note: 2023 全年 4014 条，第一名 1130 vs 第二名 530，差距够大

m04.code: t = dfs['评论'].groupby('房源编号').size().sort_values(ascending=False).head(5); result = dfs['房源'].set_index('房源编号')['社区'].reindex(t.index)
m04.note: 有序 5 元组；并列时按 pandas 默认序，题面已要求按评论数降序

m05.code: j = dfs['评论'].merge(dfs['房源'][['房源编号','房型']], on='房源编号', how='left'); result = j['房型'].value_counts().idxmax()
m05.raw_code: j = dfs['评论'].merge(dfs['房源'][['id','room_type']], left_on='listing_id', right_on='id', how='left'); result = j['room_type'].value_counts().idxmax()

m06.code: big = dfs['房源'][dfs['房源']['可住人数'] >= 4]['房源编号']; c = dfs['可订日历']; result = round((c[c['房源编号'].isin(big)]['可订'] == 't').sum() / len(big), 2)
m06.raw_code: big = dfs['房源'][dfs['房源']['accommodates'] >= 4]['id']; c = dfs['可订日历']; result = round((c[c['listing_id'].isin(big)]['available'] == 't').sum() / len(big), 2)

m08.code: h = dfs['房源']['房东编号'].value_counts().index[0]; result = int(dfs['房源'][dfs['房源']['房东编号'] == h]['评论数'].sum())
m08.raw_code: h = dfs['房源']['host_id'].value_counts().index[0]; result = int(dfs['房源'][dfs['房源']['host_id'] == h]['number_of_reviews'].sum())
m08.note: 该房东 31 套，唯一不并列；192 条

m09.code: p = dfs['房源']['每晚价格']; num = pd.to_numeric(p.str.replace('$', '', regex=False).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce'); result = int(dfs['房源'][num.isna()]['评论数'].sum())
m09.raw_code: p = dfs['房源']['price']; num = pd.to_numeric(p.str.replace('$', '', regex=False).str.replace(',', '', regex=False), errors='coerce'); result = int(dfs['房源'][num.isna()]['number_of_reviews'].sum())

m11.code: L = dfs['房源'].copy(); L['_s'] = pd.to_numeric(L['评分'], errors='coerce'); g = L.groupby('社区').agg(n=('房源编号', 'size'), s=('_s', 'mean')); g = g[g['n'] >= 20]; result = g['s'].idxmax()
m11.raw_code: L = dfs['房源'].copy(); L['_s'] = pd.to_numeric(L['review_scores_rating'], errors='coerce'); g = L.groupby('neighbourhood_cleansed').agg(n=('id', 'size'), s=('_s', 'mean')); g = g[g['n'] >= 20]; result = g['s'].idxmax()
m11.note: 不限样本量时 EIGHTH WARD(14 套) 会赢，那条路是噪声

m12.code: result = '无法回答：数据中只有可订状态（可订=t/f），没有实际入住记录，无法计算入住率'
m12.note: 应拒答：日历只有 availability，没有 booking

h1_07.code: v1 = pd.to_numeric(df['PM2.5'], errors='coerce'); v2 = pd.to_numeric(df['PM10'], errors='coerce'); result = round(float(v1.corr(v2)), 3)
h1_07.note: corr 默认按有效对计算（pairwise），两边都不缺失才进分母

h1_08.code: t = pd.to_datetime(df['监测时间'], format='%Y/%m/%d %H'); v = pd.to_numeric(df['PM2.5'], errors='coerce'); days = t.dt.normalize().groupby(t.dt.year).nunique(); full = days[days >= 365].index; g = pd.DataFrame({'y': t.dt.year, 'v': v}); result = int(g[g['y'].isin(full)].groupby('y')['v'].mean().idxmax())
h1_08.raw_code: d = df.assign(_d=pd.to_datetime(df[['year', 'month', 'day']])); days = d.groupby('year')['_d'].nunique(); full = days[days >= 365].index; result = int(d[d['year'].isin(full)].groupby('year')['PM2.5'].mean().idxmax())

h1_09.code: p = pd.to_numeric(df['降水量'], errors='coerce'); v = pd.to_numeric(df['PM2.5'], errors='coerce'); result = round(float(v[p > 0].mean()), 2)
h1_09.note: 降水 16520 条，雨天均值 62.39 低于全表 79.79（湿沉降）

h1_10.note: 中位数 55.0 远低于均值 79.79，长尾（最高 999）拉高均值

h1_11.code: v = pd.to_numeric(df['PM2.5'], errors='coerce'); result = round(100.0 * int((v <= 75).sum()) / int(v.notna().sum()), 2)
h1_11.note: 分母是有数值的记录 412029；用全表 420768 会得 59.66（口径差 1.26pp）

h1_12.code: t = pd.to_datetime(df['监测时间'], format='%Y/%m/%d %H'); v = pd.to_numeric(df['PM2.5'], errors='coerce'); d = pd.DataFrame({'day': t.dt.normalize(), 'v': v}).groupby('day')['v'].mean(); result = round(100.0 * float((d > 75).mean()), 2)
h1_12.note: 1461 天里 588 天日均超 75；按记录算（h1_02 口径）会得到不同的数

h1_13.code: v = pd.to_numeric(df['PM2.5'], errors='coerce'); result = pd.DataFrame({'w': df['风向'], 'v': v}).groupby('w')['v'].mean().idxmax()
h1_13.note: ESE 102.01 最高，NW 51.43 最低（西北风最干净）；'未登记' 组 100.18 排第三不影响

h1_14.code: v = pd.to_numeric(df['PM2.5'], errors='coerce'); t = pd.to_numeric(df['气温'], errors='coerce'); result = round(float(t.corr(v)), 2)
h1_14.note: 弱负相关 -0.13：线性关系很弱，不能说'气温越低污染越重'有多强

h1_15.code: v = pd.to_numeric(df['PM2.5'], errors='coerce'); result = pd.DataFrame({'s': df['监测站'], 'v': v}).groupby('s')['v'].mean().sort_values().head(3).index.tolist()
h1_15.note: Dingling 65.99 / Huairou 69.63 / Changping 71.10，与第 4 名 Shunyi 79.49 有明显断层

h1_16.code: t = pd.to_datetime(df['监测时间'], format='%Y/%m/%d %H'); v = pd.to_numeric(df['PM2.5'], errors='coerce'); a = float(v[t.dt.year == 2013].mean()); b = float(v[t.dt.year == 2016].mean()); result = round(100.0 * (a - b) / a, 2)
h1_16.raw_code: a = float(df[df['year'] == 2013]['PM2.5'].mean()); b = float(df[df['year'] == 2016]['PM2.5'].mean()); result = round(100.0 * (a - b) / a, 2)

h1_18.code: t = pd.to_datetime(df['监测时间'], format='%Y/%m/%d %H'); v = pd.to_numeric(df['PM2.5'], errors='coerce'); g = pd.DataFrame({'s': df['监测站'], 'y': t.dt.year, 'v': v}); p = g[g['y'].isin([2013, 2016])].pivot_table(index='s', columns='y', values='v', aggfunc='mean'); result = ((p[2013] - p[2016]) / p[2013]).idxmax()
h1_18.raw_code: g = df[df['year'].isin([2013, 2016])]; p = g.pivot_table(index='station', columns='year', values='PM2.5', aggfunc='mean'); result = ((p[2013] - p[2016]) / p[2013]).idxmax()
h1_18.note: Wanliu 22.02%（91.60 -> 71.42），最小 Gucheng 5.58%，12 站降幅差异明显
